'''Werewolves''' are found in [[Canifis]]. They appear as level 24 humans wandering the village until they are attacked, causing them to transform into level 88 werewolves unless the player attacks with [[Wolfbane]], in which case they will remain in human form as long as it is equipped. They will always drop [[wolf bones]], regardless of their form upon death. However, their human and werewolf forms have a separate loot table.

Werewolves do not count towards a regular [[wolf]] slayer task. Additionally, it is important to note that they will only count towards a werewolf [[Slayer task]] if killed after transforming: killing them in their human form with Wolfbane will '''not''' award experience or decrease the slayer task counter.

Werewolves can also be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] (and [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon|Wilderness version]]). These are slightly stronger than their Canifis variant, and aggressive to those not wearing an item of [[Zamorak]]. The [[werewolf bone]] for [[Rag and Bone Man II]] is not dropped in the God Wars Dungeon, only from the werewolves in Canifis.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1473349491050881028|date=21 December 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100585|archivedate=21 December 2021|quote=All 20 transformed versions are in the list; the untransformed versions are not.|group=d}}

==Strategy==
There are multiple strategies that can work to reduce damage and speed up the task when killing these for Slayer:

* Players with an [[Agility]] level of 40 or higher can set up a [[dwarf multicannon]] in the middle of Canifis, then immediately run south-east and begin the [[Canifis Rooftop Course]]. This not only allows the cannon to fire at every Werewolf within range as if it were a [[multicombat area]], players can also earn Agility experience and [[marks of grace]] while the task completes. As long as the player is on the rooftops, the Werewolves will wander around the area and take damage from the cannon. The cannon will need to be reloaded every other lap or so, depending on course speed and how many Werewolves stay within its range.

* Alternatively, players can set up a dwarf multicannon, run into any nearby building, and close the door. The Werewolves will become aggressive and stack up behind the closed door. Since the player is not actively taking damage, the cannon will target all of them. You will occasionally need to run outside to reload the cannon. This method can be more tedious, as the Werewolves typically stack behind the door in a way that makes it difficult for the cannon to target them. Moving around inside the building should spread them out and alleviate this issue.
* Players using Melee should attack with [[Wolfbane]] equipped, preventing the Werewolf's transition to its wolf form. When their health is very low as a human, switch to a different weapon. It will regain 38 health in the transformation to wolf form, but will ultimately cause less damage than if it were a wolf the entire time.
* Werewolves can also be [[Safespot|safespotted]] over the [[STASH unit|STASH]] in the middle of Canifis village, from behind the bar in the Canifis pub, or across the two tables located inside. There are 4 werewolves inside the bar. '''Note if you are safespotting;''' you will stop attacking when the human turns to the werewolf form.
